generalAbilities.name: Ley Line Sense (Imprecise)
generalAbilities.description: The myroga can sense the presence, direction, and strength of any ley line within 1 mile.

defensiveAbilities.name: Reactive Strike (Fangs Only)
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

defensiveAbilities.name: Resistance 5 to Physical Near a Ley Line
defensiveAbilities.description: The myroga has resistance to physical 5 while within 500 feet of a ley line.

offensiveAbilities.name: Draconic Frenzy
offensiveAbilities.description: The myroga makes two talon Strikes and one tail Strike in any order.

offensiveAbilities.name: Ley Line Empowerment
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The myroga is within 500 feet of a ley line

Effect The myroga wreathes itself in raw destructive energy converted from the ley line's ambient magic. The myroga deals an additional 2d6 Force Damage with each of its next successful fangs, tail, and talon Strike. Once its dealt damage with one of these Strikes, the energy is discharged from that body part, but not the others.

offensiveAbilities.name: Ley Line Rupture
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The myroga is within 500 feet of a ley line

Effect The myroga diverts some of the ley line's magic into a deadly and distant explosion. The myroga creates a detonation of force in a 5-foot square within a mile of its ley line and that it can see, dealing 5d6 Force Damage to creatures (Basic DC 24 Reflex Saving Throw). A myroga can will the detonation into existence anywhere within a mile of the ley line, possibly allowing it to ignore cover the target might have from, for example, an obstacle between itself and the myroga.

lv3spells.name: Grim Tendrils
lv3spells.description:
Tendrils of darkness curl out from your fingertips and race through the air. You deal 2d4 void damage and (@item.level) Bleed Damage damage to living creatures in the line. Each living creature in the line must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half the void damage and no persistent bleed damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage.

Critical Failure The creature takes double void damage and double persistent bleed damage.

Heightened (+1) The void damage increases by 2d4, and the persistent bleed damage increases by 1.
